registry.custodian: 台山市自然资源局 / 台山市不动产登记局（Taishan Natural Resources Bureau / Taishan Real Estate Registration Bureau）
registry.evidence: The official Taishan government portal identifies the Natural Resources Bureau as a city government department. Its official organizational page identifies the subordinate Taishan Real Estate Registration Bureau, responsible for citywide natural-resource and real-estate registration, cadastral investigation, real-estate surveying, dispute handling, and management/use of registration results.
registry.scope: Citywide registration and cadastral-administration remit is evidenced. Public anonymous parcel feature access, citywide polygon coverage, schema, CRS, and exact-point parcel availability are not evidenced.
